thesisSummary: Foxglove Fund II leads $3-12M seed and Series A rounds in advanced-materials spinouts that make electrification cheaper and more reliable. Its targets are energy storage beyond conventional Li-ion (sodium/sulfur chemistries, electrolytes, capacitor dielectrics), earth-abundant electrolysis catalysts that replace platinum-group metals, rare-earth-free magnets, and abundant-element thin-film solar absorbers. It requires measured performance against an industry benchmark plus a scalable manufacturing route, and an exclusive license to filed US/PCT applications (provisionals only with a conversion plan); carbon removal, software, sensors/cameras, medical devices and life sciences are excluded.
